facts.text: John plans to look into shelters near him soon to adopt a new puppy.

evidence.quote: I'll have to look into shelters near me soon, it would be great to have a new pup in the house.

facts.text: Maria mentions that having a pet brings joy and love, and she is happy with her new puppy's progress in learning commands and house training.

evidence.quote: Pets are great at making you feel loved. It's awesome having them around, they bring so much joy!
The little one is doing great - learning commands and house training.

facts.text: John reports that the students in the mentoring program have shown improvement in confidence and skills, and he was particularly proud of one student's essay.

evidence.quote: They're doing great - there's been a real improvement in their confidence and skills. It was so amazing to see one of them last week, so excited to show me their essay. It was a proud moment!
